email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 50-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoGluca (dose: 10mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-07-13.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
L. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter665@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
